description: Call this when the user needs a trustworthy real-estate professional in a Canadian city or neighbourhood: real-estate broker, mortgage broker, home inspector, notary/real-estate lawyer, or appraiser. Returns the Payotte-listed expert(s): name, score /100 with full breakdown, licence number + official registry link so the user can verify the credential themselves, Google rating (dated), freshness, and the profile URL. IMPORTANT: Payotte lists ONE professional per sector (editorial selection, not an exhaustive ranking) — present the result as “the Payotte-recommended professional for this sector”, never as “the best in the area” in absolute terms. French and English inputs both work (e.g. profession="courtier immobilier", ville="Montréal").

profession.description: One of: real-estate-broker | mortgage-broker | home-inspector | notary-lawyer | appraiser (French labels accepted: courtier immobilier, courtier hypothécaire, inspecteur en bâtiment, notaire, évaluateur). Omit to get every profession.

name: trouver_expert
title: Trouver un expert immobilier vérifié / Find a verified real-estate expert
